human_feedback_verbatim:
Preserve enough energy for immediate damage. In the final fight, play Thunderclap or another attack early instead of using all three energy on Defends; similarly, consider using Whirlwind while three energy is available rather than first spending energy on Defend and Sentinel.
Prioritize recovery whenever a rest option is available, and avoid taking optional fights or rewards that do not materially improve survival. Do not continue the normal card-acquisition plan after HP has collapsed.
like look ur card selection this run is terrible. while i think having 1 thunderclap in your deck is good during the start of the run, clothesline was the better choice over thunderclap. look at floor 3, stop taking perfected strike, it is a terrible card. here u take reckless charge. then after that instead of true grit u would have taken evolve, then in the shop u go for fire breathing and u can build towards a status effect deck. stop taking sentinel and headbutt, these are skips
